verdict.rationale: Honeycomb is an observability platform, so error tracking is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents errors grouped into issues, stack-trace views, release tracking, or regression detection. Markers and MCP-assisted investigation of 'error spikes' are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection
